value.rationale: For an established bounded mixed-Poisson model, allowing its endpoint to track log n creates a qualitatively new lattice-extreme regime. The endpoint-power alpha shifts critical maxima by an unbounded, explicitly sharp multiple of log log n relative to pure Poisson, and the independent Gamma/Geometric marks identify the latent sources of extreme counts. This is a motivated calibration and localization theorem, not a routine restatement of a fixed-endpoint tail classification.
